name: agent-memory
description: Team memory for Claude Code: search, add, edit and delete memory through the memory MCP, save every turn to the agent's raw history (L0), and load the agent's profile and scenes at session start.

memory_url.title: Memory server URL
memory_url.description: Base URL of the memory MCP server, without /mcp. Local stack: http://localhost:8097. WAIP: the agent-memory URL from the MCP store's Connection tab, without the trailing /mcp.

memory_key.title: Your memory key
memory_key.description: Your personal sk-mem key from the Memory Hub panel's API Key page.

agent_id.title: Agent ID (optional)
agent_id.description: Which of your agents to use. Leave empty if you own only one agent.

platform_token.title: WAIP token (WAIP only)
platform_token.description: Only when the memory server is reached through WAIP: the service token from the MCP store's Connection tab. Leave empty for a local server.
